title: roles.pick
description: client → server. PICK mode: the sender claims a role group, or releases the current claim with null. A player holds at most one group; claiming another releases the previous one. The server broadcasts roles.state.

lead.description: Lead role of the group to claim (see `roles.state.groups[].lead`), or null to release.

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.
